dict.string: Luma Bar requires permission to control Apple Music and NetEase Cloud Music via AppleScript to synchronize playback status and display lyrics.
luma bar looks up a contact only when you ask the Agent to prepare a message to that person.
luma bar may access the Desktop only for files you select or Agent actions you confirm.
luma bar may access Documents only for files you select or Agent actions you confirm.
luma bar may access Downloads only for files you select or Agent actions you confirm.
Luma Bar uses the microphone only when you start Voice Whisper, to turn speech into text.
luma bar may access network volumes only for files you select or Agent actions you confirm.
luma bar may access removable volumes only for files you select or Agent actions you confirm.
luma bar captures the active game window only when you request screenshot analysis.
Luma Bar uses speech recognition only when you start Voice Whisper, to turn speech into text.
